description: Defines the ClusterMember class representing a node in a cluster, including its address, status, and name, with methods for equality comparison and string representation.

classes.name: ClusterMember
classes.description: Represents a cluster node with address, status, and name, providing equality and string methods.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Initializes a new ClusterMember with specified silo address, status, and name.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines if another object or ClusterMember is equal based on address, status, and name.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the silo address.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Generates a string representation including address, name, and status.
